name: Nha Trang to Da Lat
summary: Go by road. Da Lat is 205 km from Nha Trang, and buses run. The minutes are Check on arrival. There is no train into Da Lat.

modes.note: About 205 km by road. Buses run from Nha Trang. No clock is published. Fares are Check on arrival.
Da Lat’s line no longer joins the north–south railway. The station runs only a short tourist train to Trại Mát.

faqs.q: Is Da Lat back to Nha Trang the same trip?
faqs.a: Yes. This page covers both directions. The road back is the same 205 km, and the minutes are still Check on arrival.
